subject: Office chair arrived damaged and won't adjust
body: Hi, I bought an office chair from your Xinjiekou store last week and I'm pretty disappointed with what turned up. The box was already bashed in on one side when I got it, and when I opened it the chair had a crack in the base. I thought maybe it was just the packaging and the chair would be fine, but the height adjustment doesn't work either — it stays stuck at the lowest setting no matter what I do. I tried following the assembly instructions again and checked the lever, but nothing changes. I don't really want to keep messing with it at this point. Can you let me know what my options are? I'd rather not have to haul it back across town if there's another way.
